data.credibility: Management has not provided specific quantified guidance in the provided text, but they have successfully scaled core operating metrics such as demat accounts and KYC records significantly over the period.
bull: CDSL maintains a dominant market share of 80% while crossing 18 crore demat accounts during FY 2025-26.
The company is virtually debt-free with nominal borrowings of ₹2 cr against a net worth of ₹1,984 cr.
Operating cash flow was 97% of reported profit over 5 years, demonstrating strong cash conversion.
bear: EBITDA margin narrowed notably from 61.6% in FY21 to 50.8% in FY26.
Working-capital days stretched significantly from -110 to -32 over the last 5 years.
Net profit compounded at 17.8% annually, lagging behind the 27.2% annual revenue growth over 5 years.
